take_text.01-hook: That jump started with a bite.
take_text.02-trap: Her feet are sliding. And at the bottom of the pit, there's an antlion.
take_text.03-air: Those jaws can snap in midair. But the ant doesn't lift.
take_text.04-sand: Same snap, this time against sand. One launch clears the rim.
take_text.06-question: Then researchers glued some ants' jaws shut. Same trap. But now, could they still get out?
